```{r}
library(rentrez)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)


search_term <- paste(
  "(ulcerative colitis OR inflammatory bowel disease)",
  "AND",
  "(colorectal cancer OR colitis-associated cancer)",
  "AND",
  '("2020/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2026/12/31"[Date - Publication])'
)

search <- entrez_search(
  db = "pubmed",
  term = search_term,
  retmax = 1500,
  sort = "pub date"
)

pmids <- search$ids

length(pmids)

fetch_paper <- function(id){

  s <- entrez_summary(db="pubmed", id=id)

  data.frame(
    PMID = id,
    Title = s$title,
    Journal = s$fulljournalname,
    Year = substr(s$pubdate,1,4),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

}

papers <- map_dfr(pmids, fetch_paper)

head(papers)

papers %>%
  count(Year) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = n))+

  geom_col(fill="steelblue")+

  geom_text(aes(label=n),vjust=-0.4)+

  theme_classic(base_size=14)+

  labs(
    x="Publication Year",
    y="Number of Papers"
  )

papers %>%
  count(Journal, sort=TRUE) %>%
  slice(1:15) %>%

  ggplot(aes(reorder(Journal,n),n))+

  geom_col(fill="darkgreen")+

  coord_flip()+

  theme_bw(base_size=13)+

  labs(
    x="Journal",
    y="Number of Papers"
  )


```


```{r}
papers$Category <- "Other"

papers$Category[str_detect(tolower(papers$Title),
                           "endoscopy|colonoscopy|chromoendoscopy|nbi")] <- "Endoscopy"

papers$Category[str_detect(tolower(papers$Title),
                           "surveillance|screening")] <- "Surveillance"

papers$Category[str_detect(tolower(papers$Title),
                           "biomarker|marker")] <- "Biomarkers"

papers$Category[str_detect(tolower(papers$Title),
                           "microbiome|microbiota|16s|metagenom")] <- "Microbiome"

papers$Category[str_detect(tolower(papers$Title),
                           "rna|transcriptom|gene expression|single-cell")] <- "Transcriptomics"

papers$Category[str_detect(tolower(papers$Title),
                           "genomic|dna|mutation|sequencing")] <- "Genomics"

papers$Category[str_detect(tolower(papers$Title),
                           "proteomic|protein")] <- "Proteomics"

papers$Category[str_detect(tolower(papers$Title),
                           "metabolomic")] <- "Metabolomics"

papers$Category[str_detect(tolower(papers$Title),
                           "artificial intelligence|machine learning|deep learning|cnn|transformer|ai")] <- "AI"

papers$Category[str_detect(tolower(papers$Title),
                           "clinical|cohort|patient")] <- "Clinical"

papers$Category[str_detect(tolower(papers$Title),
                           "histology|pathology|biopsy")] <- "Histology"


write.csv(
  papers,
  file = "out1/PubMed_Papers.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

fig1 <- papers %>%
  count(Year) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.4) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Publication Year",
    y = "Number of Papers",
    title = "Publication Trend"
  )

fig1

ggsave(
  filename = "out1/Figure1_Publication_Trend.png",
  plot = fig1,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

fig2 <- papers %>%
  count(Journal, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1:15) %>%
  ggplot(aes(reorder(Journal, n), n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkgreen") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    x = "Journal",
    y = "Number of Papers",
    title = "Top 15 Journals"
  )

fig2

ggsave(
  filename = "out1/Figure2_Top_Journals.png",
  plot = fig2,
  width = 10,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)

year_summary <- papers %>%
  count(Year)

write.csv(
  year_summary,
  "out1/Publication_by_Year.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


journal_summary <- papers %>%
  count(Journal, sort = TRUE)

write.csv(
  journal_summary,
  "out1/Top_Journals.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
library(tidytext)

pp <- papers %>%
  unnest_tokens(word,Title) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words,by="word") %>%
  count(word,sort=TRUE) %>%
  slice(1:20) %>%

  ggplot(aes(reorder(word,n),n))+

  geom_col(fill="orange")+

  coord_flip()+

  theme_bw(base_size=13)

print(pp)

ggsave(
  filename = "out1/research_topic_papers.png",
  plot = pp,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

write.csv(
  papers,
  "IBD_CRC_1500papers.csv",
  row.names=FALSE
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

papers %>%
  group_by(Category) %>%
  summarise(
    Number_of_Papers = n(),
    PMIDs = paste(PMID, collapse = ", ")
  ) -> category_table

category_table


```









```{r}
library(dplyr)

category_table <- papers %>%
  group_by(Category) %>%
  summarise(
    Number_of_Papers = n(),
    PMIDs = paste(PMID, collapse = "; "),
    Years = paste(Year, collapse = "; "),
    Journals = paste(Journal, collapse = "; "),
    Titles = paste(Title, collapse = " | "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

category_table

write.csv(category_table,
          "Category_Summary.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)


```
